applies_why: The judge text uses the absence of an explicit verse statement as the reason to mark points UNDERDETERMINED, which is the thing K-S2 governs.
quote: GROUND: line on line, neither route is stated in so many words.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: "a single verse does not state a link or its contrary ... never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED": I weighed reading it as forbidding only reliance on one verse's silence, versus reading it as forbidding reliance on the absence of an explicit statement in the cited row(s).
why: The quoted ground makes "neither route is stated in so many words" the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids.
